remarks: Perfect combination of privacy and convenience! Beautiful 2 bedroom End Unit in the popular Newfield East Complex. Bright and sunny Living Room. Large Kitchen with Marble Floor, Corian Counters, Tiled Backsplash, SS Appliances, Pantry and plenty of Storage. Dining Room with Hardwood Floors and Sliders to Deck, for Family meals and Entertaining. Skylight and Exposed Beams add Character, Light and Charm. 1/2 Bath on main level newly renovated, with Tile Floor and Black Matte Fixtures. Primary Bedroom and second Bedroom on upper level, with Hardwood Floors and tons of Closet Space. Large Full Bath on Upper Level with Double Sinks, Marble Backsplash and Floor, Large Tub, and Glassed Stall Shower. Green Space and Back Deck add outdoor living! Newfield Shopping Center just steps away and trains and highway just 10 mins away!
